title: 李渊太原起兵
titleEn: Li Yuan Raises Army at Taiyuan
summary: 隋末天下大乱，太原留守李渊在次子李世民的极力劝说下起兵反隋，打出「尊隋讨贼」旗号。
summaryEn: Amid the Sui collapse, Li Yuan raised an army at Li Shimin's urging, under the banner of 'honoring Sui, punishing rebels.'
description: 隋末天下大乱，太原留守李渊在次子李世民的极力劝说下起兵反隋，打出「尊隋讨贼」旗号。
descriptionEn: Amid the Sui collapse, Li Yuan raised an army at Li Shimin's urging, under the banner of 'honoring Sui, punishing rebels.'

title: 李渊建立唐朝
summary: 李渊接受隋恭帝禅让，在长安称帝建立唐朝，年号武德。
summaryEn: Li Yuan accepted the abdication of the last Sui emperor and proclaimed the Tang dynasty at Chang'an.
description: 李渊接受隋恭帝禅让，在长安称帝建立唐朝，年号武德。
descriptionEn: Li Yuan accepted the abdication of the last Sui emperor and proclaimed the Tang dynasty at Chang'an.

title: 玄武门之变与李渊退位
summary: 玄武门之变后李渊被迫退位为太上皇，李世民即位。
summaryEn: After the Xuanwu Gate Incident, Li Yuan was forced to abdicate and became Retired Emperor.
description: 玄武门之变后李渊被迫退位为太上皇，李世民即位。
descriptionEn: After the Xuanwu Gate Incident, Li Yuan was forced to abdicate and became Retired Emperor.

title: 唐高宗即位
summary: 太宗驾崩后第九子李治即位，在长孙无忌等大臣辅佐下前期颇有作为。
summaryEn: After Taizong's death, Li Zhi ascended as Emperor Gaozong, achieving much under Zhangsun Wuji's guidance.
description: 太宗驾崩后第九子李治即位，在长孙无忌等大臣辅佐下前期颇有作为。
descriptionEn: After Taizong's death, Li Zhi ascended as Emperor Gaozong, achieving much under Zhangsun Wuji's guidance.

title: 唐朝疆域达到极盛
summary: 高宗时期灭西突厥、百济和高句丽，唐朝疆域东至朝鲜半岛、西达咸海。
summaryEn: Tang destroyed Western Turks, Baekje, and Goguryeo, reaching its greatest territorial extent.
description: 高宗时期灭西突厥、百济和高句丽，唐朝疆域东至朝鲜半岛、西达咸海。
descriptionEn: Tang destroyed Western Turks, Baekje, and Goguryeo, reaching its greatest territorial extent.

title: 武则天立后与二圣临朝
summary: 李治不顾长孙无忌等重臣反对将武则天立为皇后。660年后高宗风疾无法理政，武则天逐渐掌权并称「二圣」。
summaryEn: Li Zhi made Wu Zetian empress despite fierce opposition. After his stroke in 660, Wu gradually took control.
description: 李治不顾长孙无忌等重臣反对将武则天立为皇后。660年后高宗风疾无法理政，武则天逐渐掌权并称「二圣」。
descriptionEn: Li Zhi made Wu Zetian empress despite fierce opposition. After his stroke in 660, Wu gradually took control.

title: 唐隆政变与先天政变
summary: 李隆基先后发动唐隆政变和先天政变，铲除韦后和太平公主集团，真正掌握大权。
summaryEn: Li Longji launched two coups, eliminating Empress Wei and Princess Taiping's factions to seize power.
description: 李隆基先后发动唐隆政变和先天政变，铲除韦后和太平公主集团，真正掌握大权。
descriptionEn: Li Longji launched two coups, eliminating Empress Wei and Princess Taiping's factions to seize power.

title: 开元盛世
summary: 开元年间玄宗任用姚崇、宋璟等贤相，唐朝达到全盛——长安是世界第一大都市，人口达到五千万。
summaryEn: Under wise ministers Yao Chong and Song Jing, Tang reached its zenith — Chang'an was the world's largest city.
description: 开元年间玄宗任用姚崇、宋璟等贤相，唐朝达到全盛——长安是世界第一大都市，人口达到五千万。
descriptionEn: Under wise ministers Yao Chong and Song Jing, Tang reached its zenith — Chang'an was the world's largest city.

title: 安史之乱爆发
summary: 755年安禄山在范阳起兵叛乱，唐朝由盛转衰的转折点。玄宗被迫逃往四川。
summaryEn: In 755, An Lushan rebelled at Fanyang — the turning point from Tang's peak to its decline.
description: 755年安禄山在范阳起兵叛乱，唐朝由盛转衰的转折点。玄宗被迫逃往四川。
descriptionEn: In 755, An Lushan rebelled at Fanyang — the turning point from Tang's peak to its decline.

title: 马嵬坡兵变
summary: 逃难途中禁军哗变，杨国忠被杀，玄宗被迫赐死杨贵妃。白居易《长恨歌》即以此为题材。
summaryEn: The Imperial Guard mutinied — Yang Guozhong killed, Yang Guifei strangled. Immortalized in Bai Juyi's 'Song of Everlasting Sorrow.'
description: 逃难途中禁军哗变，杨国忠被杀，玄宗被迫赐死杨贵妃。白居易《长恨歌》即以此为题材。
descriptionEn: The Imperial Guard mutinied — Yang Guozhong killed, Yang Guifei strangled. Immortalized in Bai Juyi's 'Song of Everlasting Sorrow.'

title: 唐宪宗即位决心削藩
summary: 李纯即位为唐宪宗，面对藩镇割据的严峻局面，决心以武力削藩。
summaryEn: Li Chun ascended as Emperor Xianzong, determined to subdue autonomous provinces by force.
description: 李纯即位为唐宪宗，面对藩镇割据的严峻局面，决心以武力削藩。
descriptionEn: Li Chun ascended as Emperor Xianzong, determined to subdue autonomous provinces by force.

title: 雪夜入蔡州
summary: 李愬雪夜奇袭蔡州，生擒淮西节度使吴元济，是中国军事史上最著名的奇袭战例之一。
summaryEn: Li Su's surprise night raid captured Wu Yuanji alive — one of history's most famous surprise attacks.
description: 李愬雪夜奇袭蔡州，生擒淮西节度使吴元济，是中国军事史上最著名的奇袭战例之一。
descriptionEn: Li Su's surprise night raid captured Wu Yuanji alive — one of history's most famous surprise attacks.

title: 元和中兴
summary: 到819年全国藩镇表面上全部听命于中央，史称「元和中兴」。
summaryEn: By 819, all provinces nominally submitted to the center — the Yuanhe Restoration.
description: 到819年全国藩镇表面上全部听命于中央，史称「元和中兴」。
descriptionEn: By 819, all provinces nominally submitted to the center — the Yuanhe Restoration.

title: 孙思邈著《千金要方》
titleEn: Essential Formulas Worth a Thousand Gold
summary: 药王孙思邈完成医学巨著《备急千金要方》30卷，系统总结唐代以前的医学成就。
summaryEn: The King of Medicine completed his 30-volume masterpiece, systematically summarizing pre-Tang medical knowledge.
description: 药王孙思邈完成医学巨著《备急千金要方》30卷，系统总结唐代以前的医学成就。
descriptionEn: The King of Medicine completed his 30-volume masterpiece, systematically summarizing pre-Tang medical knowledge.

title: 李靖灭东突厥
summary: 李靖率三千精骑夜袭阴山，一举擒获颉利可汗，灭亡东突厥。
summaryEn: Li Jing led 3,000 cavalry in a night raid, capturing the Illig Qaghan and destroying the Eastern Turkic Khaganate.
description: 李靖率三千精骑夜袭阴山，一举擒获颉利可汗，灭亡东突厥。
descriptionEn: Li Jing led 3,000 cavalry in a night raid, capturing the Illig Qaghan and destroying the Eastern Turkic Khaganate.

title: 房谋杜断——贞观之治的设计师
summary: 房玄龄与杜如晦并称「房谋杜断」，任宰相二十余年，是贞观之治的核心设计师。
summaryEn: Fang Xuanling and Du Ruhui were the chief architects of the Zhenguan Reign, with Fang serving as chancellor for over 20 years.
description: 房玄龄与杜如晦并称「房谋杜断」，任宰相二十余年，是贞观之治的核心设计师。
descriptionEn: Fang Xuanling and Du Ruhui were the chief architects of the Zhenguan Reign, with Fang serving as chancellor for over 20 years.

title: 杜如晦任相
summary: 杜如晦以果断善断著称，与房玄龄配合默契，可惜英年早逝。
summaryEn: Du Ruhui, famed for decisiveness alongside Fang Xuanling, died young in 630.
description: 杜如晦以果断善断著称，与房玄龄配合默契，可惜英年早逝。
descriptionEn: Du Ruhui, famed for decisiveness alongside Fang Xuanling, died young in 630.

title: 狄仁杰劝谏武则天
summary: 狄仁杰在武则天朝任宰相，以智慧和勇气劝谏武则天，为恢复李唐江山奠定基础。
summaryEn: Di Renjie served as chancellor under Wu Zetian, subtly persuading her to return power to the Li family.
description: 狄仁杰在武则天朝任宰相，以智慧和勇气劝谏武则天，为恢复李唐江山奠定基础。
descriptionEn: Di Renjie served as chancellor under Wu Zetian, subtly persuading her to return power to the Li family.

title: 慧能作偈得传衣钵
titleEn: Huineng's Verse Wins the Patriarch's Robe
summary: 不识字的岭南樵夫慧能以「本来无一物，何处惹尘埃」的偈语，被五祖弘忍秘密传授禅宗衣钵。
summaryEn: The illiterate woodcutter Huineng won the Chan patriarch's robe with his verse on original emptiness.
description: 不识字的岭南樵夫慧能以「本来无一物，何处惹尘埃」的偈语，被五祖弘忍秘密传授禅宗衣钵。
descriptionEn: The illiterate woodcutter Huineng won the Chan patriarch's robe with his verse on original emptiness.

title: 慧能开坛说法开创南宗禅
summary: 慧能隐居十五年后在广州法性寺正式开坛说法，「直指人心，见性成佛」使禅宗彻底中国化。
summaryEn: After 15 years in hiding, Huineng began teaching, making Chan Buddhism thoroughly Chinese.
description: 慧能隐居十五年后在广州法性寺正式开坛说法，「直指人心，见性成佛」使禅宗彻底中国化。
descriptionEn: After 15 years in hiding, Huineng began teaching, making Chan Buddhism thoroughly Chinese.

title: 骆宾王写《讨武曌檄》
summary: 骆宾王为徐敬业起草讨伐武则天的檄文，武则天读后叹道「宰相安得失此人」。
summaryEn: Luo Binwang drafted the manifesto against Wu Zetian; Wu herself lamented losing such talent.
description: 骆宾王为徐敬业起草讨伐武则天的檄文，武则天读后叹道「宰相安得失此人」。
descriptionEn: Luo Binwang drafted the manifesto against Wu Zetian; Wu herself lamented losing such talent.

title: 王勃写《滕王阁序》
summary: 王勃在滕王阁宴会上即兴写下千古名篇，「落霞与孤鹜齐飞，秋水共长天一色」。
summaryEn: Wang Bo improvised the immortal Preface at a banquet, producing one of Chinese literature's greatest works.
description: 王勃在滕王阁宴会上即兴写下千古名篇，「落霞与孤鹜齐飞，秋水共长天一色」。
descriptionEn: Wang Bo improvised the immortal Preface at a banquet, producing one of Chinese literature's greatest works.

title: 张旭——草圣
titleEn: Zhang Xu: Sage of Cursive Script
summary: 张旭被尊为「草圣」，嗜酒大醉后以头发蘸墨书写，与怀素并称「颠张醉素」。
summaryEn: Zhang Xu, the Sage of Cursive, often wrote when drunk, even dipping his hair in ink.
description: 张旭被尊为「草圣」，嗜酒大醉后以头发蘸墨书写，与怀素并称「颠张醉素」。
descriptionEn: Zhang Xu, the Sage of Cursive, often wrote when drunk, even dipping his hair in ink.

title: 僧一行编制《大衍历》
summary: 僧一行主持大规模天文测量，实测子午线长度，编制《大衍历》，精度领先世界。
summaryEn: Yi Xing led a massive astronomical survey, measured the meridian arc, and created the Dayan Calendar.
description: 僧一行主持大规模天文测量，实测子午线长度，编制《大衍历》，精度领先世界。
descriptionEn: Yi Xing led a massive astronomical survey, measured the meridian arc, and created the Dayan Calendar.

title: 吴道子画嘉陵江三百里
titleEn: Wu Daozi Paints the Jialing River
summary: 唐玄宗命吴道子在大同殿画三百里嘉陵江山水，他一日而毕，被誉为「画圣」。
summaryEn: Wu Daozi painted the entire 300-li Jialing River landscape in a single day at Datong Hall.
description: 唐玄宗命吴道子在大同殿画三百里嘉陵江山水，他一日而毕，被誉为「画圣」。
descriptionEn: Wu Daozi painted the entire 300-li Jialing River landscape in a single day at Datong Hall.

title: 旗亭画壁——王之涣斗诗
summary: 王之涣、王昌龄、高适三人在旗亭听歌女唱诗斗高下，王之涣的《凉州词》最终折服全场。
summaryEn: Three great poets competed as courtesans sang their works — Wang Zhihuan's 'Liangzhou Song' won the day.
description: 王之涣、王昌龄、高适三人在旗亭听歌女唱诗斗高下，王之涣的《凉州词》最终折服全场。
descriptionEn: Three great poets competed as courtesans sang their works — Wang Zhihuan's 'Liangzhou Song' won the day.

title: 孟浩然隐居鹿门山
titleEn: Meng Haoran's Hermitage at Lumen Mountain
summary: 孟浩然终身布衣隐居鹿门山，开创盛唐山水田园诗派，与王维并称「王孟」。
summaryEn: Meng Haoran lived as a lifelong recluse, founding the Tang landscape poetry school with Wang Wei.
description: 孟浩然终身布衣隐居鹿门山，开创盛唐山水田园诗派，与王维并称「王孟」。
descriptionEn: Meng Haoran lived as a lifelong recluse, founding the Tang landscape poetry school with Wang Wei.

title: 郭子仪平定安史之乱
titleEn: Guo Ziyi Suppresses the An Lushan Rebellion
summary: 郭子仪是平定安史之乱的第一功臣，收复两京，功高盖世而能善终。
summaryEn: Guo Ziyi was the foremost hero in suppressing the rebellion, recovering both capitals.
description: 郭子仪是平定安史之乱的第一功臣，收复两京，功高盖世而能善终。
descriptionEn: Guo Ziyi was the foremost hero in suppressing the rebellion, recovering both capitals.

title: 颜真卿——书法与忠烈
summary: 颜真卿是中国书法史上最伟大的楷书大家之一，同时以忠烈殉国闻名。
summaryEn: Yan Zhenqing was one of the greatest regular script masters and a famous loyalist martyr.
description: 颜真卿是中国书法史上最伟大的楷书大家之一，同时以忠烈殉国闻名。
descriptionEn: Yan Zhenqing was one of the greatest regular script masters and a famous loyalist martyr.

title: 柳宗元被贬永州
summary: 柳宗元因参与永贞革新失败被贬永州十年，创作了《永州八记》等千古名篇。
summaryEn: Exiled to Yongzhou for ten years after the failed Yongzhen Reform, Liu wrote his immortal Eight Records.
description: 柳宗元因参与永贞革新失败被贬永州十年，创作了《永州八记》等千古名篇。
descriptionEn: Exiled to Yongzhou for ten years after the failed Yongzhen Reform, Liu wrote his immortal Eight Records.

title: 杜牧的咏史诗
summary: 杜牧以七言绝句咏史著称，与李商隐并称「小李杜」，《阿房宫赋》等成为千古名篇。
summaryEn: Du Mu was famed for his historical quatrains, paired with Li Shangyin as 'Little Li-Du'.
description: 杜牧以七言绝句咏史著称，与李商隐并称「小李杜」，《阿房宫赋》等成为千古名篇。
descriptionEn: Du Mu was famed for his historical quatrains, paired with Li Shangyin as 'Little Li-Du'.

title: 李商隐的无题诗
summary: 李商隐以无题诗闻名，「春蚕到死丝方尽，蜡炬成灰泪始干」等深情隐晦的名句传唱至今。
summaryEn: Li Shangyin's untitled love poems, veiled in passion, remain among the most moving Chinese verse.
description: 李商隐以无题诗闻名，「春蚕到死丝方尽，蜡炬成灰泪始干」等深情隐晦的名句传唱至今。
descriptionEn: Li Shangyin's untitled love poems, veiled in passion, remain among the most moving Chinese verse.
